trial_court: Senior Civil Judge, Madikeri, M.C No.42/2008
case_name: Lt. Coln. Mullera S. Kaverappa vs Smt Dazi Kaverappa

parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. Dazi Kaverappa (wife) & Smt.Guna Sagari (deleted with permission of the court)

facts_of_case: Marriage between parties was performed on 19.11.1997. Two sons were born. Appellant filed petition seeking dissolution of marriage on ground of desertion and cruelty.

legal_principles.principle: A petition seeking decree of divorce on the ground of cruelty should contain specific instances of cruelty.
legal_principles.held: See: NEELAM KUMAR VS. DAYA RANI

legal_principles.principle: Mere difference of opinion between the couples and ordinary wear and tear of married life do not by itself amount to cruelty.
legal_principles.held: See: SAVITHRI PANDEY VS. PREM CHANDRA PANDAY
cited_cases: SAVITHRI PANDEY VS. PREM CHANDRA PANDAY

legal_principles.principle: The parties to a dispute are required to describe the major and standard of cruelty and to lead cogent evidence to succeed in the plea of dissolution of marriage on the ground of cruelty.
Desertion means the intentional abandonment of the spouse by the other without the consent of the other and without a reasonable cause.
legal_principles.held: See: LACHMAN UTAMCHAND KIRIPALANI Vs. MEENA @ MOTA
cited_cases: LACHMAN UTAMCHAND KIRIPALANI Vs. MEENA @ MOTA

outcome.final_order: Trial court's judgment dismissing the petition was upheld.
